tips.text: Rank New Loka, The Perrin Sequence and Red Veil together; none of them cost each other standing.
Do not help Steel Meridian or Cephalon Suda while ranking New Loka; they cut its standing and a rank drop demotes you.
Spend standing left over at the daily cap on Syndicate Relic Packs from Rank 2; they give relics and a few Aya.
Treat it as Mastery fodder; the weapon is called weak and the ranks are a background chore.
